note: Conditions are repeated on comparable tasks, order varied where practical. Never compare unlike tasks as if equivalent.

conditions.name: Baseline observation
conditions.description: Observation only; no new restriction. Several comparable sessions first.

conditions.name: Restriction only
conditions.description: Existing blocker, no custom detector. Does access restriction change the environment?

conditions.name: Restriction + workspace launcher
conditions.description: Add ignite.ps1: open real project, files, terminal, first command.

conditions.name: Restriction + IF-THEN plan
conditions.description: Add the cold-state obstacle plan (expected obstacle + response).

conditions.name: Best combination + bounded research
conditions.description: Permit task dependencies through a finite research pass with expiry.

conditions.name: External accountability / environment
conditions.description: Optional: body doubling, library, coworking. Low software cost.

three_questions.experiment_A: Does access restriction change the environment? (blocker vs OS allowlist vs restricted desktop)
three_questions.experiment_B: Can Dhriti reconstruct what happened? (event completeness and lineage)
three_questions.experiment_C: Which intervention improves execution? (restriction alone vs launcher vs IF-THEN vs bounded research)

measures.anti_measure: screen_time_reduction alone is NOT a success measure
